scope.description: Whole aseprite application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Pixel drawing, layers/cels, animation and tags, palette/colour editing, image import and asset publication.

coverage.rationale: Cels, frames and publication connect several core sprite concepts, but drawing tools, rich blending, palette workflows and animation editing remain largely absent.

scope.description: Bounded procedural RGBA sprites, timed frames, layer/cel placement and captured PNG import to editable sprites and sheets.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Named sprites, layers, frames and tags hide Lua and organise reusable assets; users still specify many low-level drawing and placement details.

limitations: Captured imports require the declared RGBA8 PNG subset, binary alpha and in-canvas replacement; no general blending, scaling or interactive editing.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
